plate_comment: Alpha altitude derate latch: returns 1 while alpha must follow altitude_derate_alpha (e2m 104B +8 Altitude_Derate_Alpha), else 0. With bit 0x20 of feature_enable_flags_cal clear it clears alpha_altitude_derate_timer (e2m 104A +1A Alpha_Altitude_Derate_Timer) and returns 0. Otherwise, in every pass final_fueling_state is FUELING_STATE_ALTITUDE_DERATE it reloads the timer with altitude_derate_alpha_timeout (e2m 104B +A Altitude_Derate_Alpha_Timeout, 'time alpha is latched to ADALF after Altitude Derate stops fuel limiting') and returns 1; after the derate stops it counts the timer down by 1 per pass and keeps returning 1 until the timer is 0. Only caller hpcr_calculateFuelTrimOutput: a nonzero result selects alpha source 2 (altitude). (was cm848_checkPressureFuelState)

Alpha on governor result (e2m 104A +A Alpha_Governor, '[APGVAP] result of On Governor'): returns 1 while the engine is on a speed governor, that is final_fueling_state is FUELING_STATE_VEHICLE_SPEED_LIMIT or cruise_control_engaged_flag is 1, else 0. Called by timingProtectionFlagsOrchestrator when bit 0x2000 of governor_fault_status_flags (algorithm enable flags word 0) is set; the result is stored in fuel_rate_condition_status (0x40a172) and a 1 lets alpha_base ramp toward 1.0. (was cm848_checkFuelRateCondition)

Alpha low speed governor result (e2m 104A +C Alpha_LSG, '[APLSAP] result of LSG algorithm'): a timeout after the low speed governor last acted. While alpha_low_speed_governor_state_detected_flag is 1 it reloads cold_start_timer_a (e2m 104A +16 Alpha_LSG_Timer) with low_speed_governor_alpha_timeout (e2m 104B +14 LSG_Alpha_Timeout, 'time that must expire without LSG commanding fuel before alpha is one'), sets cold_start_timer_a_active_flag and returns 0; while the active flag is set and the timer is above 0 it counts it down by 1 per pass and returns 0; otherwise it clears the active flag and returns 1. Called by timingProtectionFlagsOrchestrator when bit 0x400 of governor_fault_status_flags (algorithm enable flags word 0) is set; the result is stored in pressure_fuel_delay_a_status (0x40a174) and a 1 lets alpha_base ramp toward 1.0. (was cm848_checkPressureFuelDelayA)

Alpha air fuel control result (e2m 104A +6 Alpha_AFC, '[APAFSS] result of AFC algorithm'): a timeout after air fuel control (or the low speed governor) last limited the fuel. While alpha_air_fuel_control_state_detected_flag or alpha_low_speed_governor_state_detected_flag is 1 it reloads cold_start_timer_b (e2m 104A +18 Alpha_AFC_Timer) with air_fuel_control_alpha_timeout (e2m 104B +6 AFC_Alpha_Timeout, 'time that must elapse without AFC limiting before ALPHA may be set to one'), sets cold_start_timer_b_active_flag and returns 0; while the active flag is set and the timer is above 0 it counts it down by 1 per pass and returns 0; otherwise it clears the active flag and returns 1. Called by timingProtectionFlagsOrchestrator when bit 0x800 of governor_fault_status_flags (algorithm enable flags word 0) is set; the result is stored in pressure_fuel_delay_b_status (0x40a16e) and a 1 lets alpha_base ramp toward 1.0. (was cm848_checkPressureFuelDelayB)

Alpha low ambient air pressure result (e2m 104A +12 Alpha_Low_Ambient_Air_Pressure, '[APAAPRSS] alpha based only on ambient air pressure logic'): a hysteresis on barometric_pressure_reference. Returns 1 (alpha may ramp to 1.0) while it is below alpha_lock_on_barometric_pressure (e2m 104B +10 Alpha_Lock_On_Air_Pressure, 'air pressure below which alpha is ramped to 1'), 0 once it is above alpha_lock_off_barometric_pressure (e2m 104B +E Alpha_Lock_Off_Air_Pressure, 'air pressure after hysteresis to unlock alpha'; ROM 1540 against 1507 for the lock on value), and the previous pressure_hysteresis_state in between. Called by timingProtectionFlagsOrchestrator when bit 0x8000 of governor_fault_status_flags (algorithm enable flags word 0) is set; the result is stored in pressure_hysteresis_state (0x40a17a). (was cm848_checkPressureHysteresis)

Boot initialization of the alpha state: clears the accumulator of the alpha fuel rate filter cold_start_intake_temperature_filter_state and points its coefficient at cold_start_intake_temperature_filter_coefficient (e2m 104B +C Alpha_Fuel_Rate_Filter_Constant, ROM 0x5be66), and sets alpha_base (e2m 104A +2 Alpha_Base), cold_start_timer_a_active_flag, cold_start_timer_b_active_flag and alpha_low_speed_governor_state_detected_flag to 0. Called once by cm848_applicationMain. (was cm848_initFuelPressureVariables)

Downstream EGR mass flow model (e2m 177F +8 CHP_Downstream_EGR_Flow, 'model of incompressible flow across fixed orifice', lb/min x 128; chosen when rpm_fuel_trim_select_cal = e2m 177E +A C_CHP_Venturi_Vrt_Sensor_Active is nonzero: 1 = downstream model). Writes the e2m 177F words of throttle_fuel_trim_t_0040a3ea: rpm_conversion = +E CHP_Downstream_Pratio (egr_orifice_delta_pressure x 32767 / map_fuel_correction_factor, the charge pressure e2m 1A2D +0 Charge_Press; limited to +-32440 = +-0.99 in Q15, +0x7eb8 when the charge pressure is 0 and the delta pressure positive); reserved_0c = +C CHP_Downstream_Corrected_Flow (3-D table of the egr_valve_position filtered by egr_valve_position_filter and that ratio, e2m 193D / 193E / 193F); reserved_16 = +16 CHP_Sqrt_Torifice_R (table of egr_orifice_temperature, e2m 1946 / 1940); load_based_trim = +8 CHP_Downstream_EGR_Flow = corrected flow x charge pressure / sqrt(orifice temperature), saturated at +-25600 (+-200 lb/min). Only caller cm848_selectFuelTrimMode. (was cm848_calculateLoadBasedFuelTrim)

Upstream EGR mass flow model (e2m 177F +A CHP_Upstream_EGR_Flow, 'empirical model relating lift and hot side dP to flow', lb/min x 128; chosen when rpm_fuel_trim_select_cal = e2m 177E +A C_CHP_Venturi_Vrt_Sensor_Active is 0: 0 = upstream model). Writes the e2m 177F words of throttle_fuel_trim_t_0040a3ea: reserved_12 = +12 CHP_Upstream_Corrected_Flow (3-D table of egr_valve_position and the exhaust to charge pressure ratio boost_pressure_state_t_0040a406.pressure_ratio = e2m 177D +A CHP_Pratio; tables e2m 18E3 / 18E4 / 18E5); reserved_10 = +10 CHP_Sqrt_Texhaust_R (table of exhaust_temperature, e2m 1974 / 1975); rpm_based_trim = +A CHP_Upstream_EGR_Flow = corrected flow x boost_pressure_current_raw (e2m 1A5D +0 Exhaust_Press) / sqrt(exhaust temperature), saturated at +-25600 (+-200 lb/min). Only caller cm848_selectFuelTrimMode. (was cm848_calculateRpmBasedFuelTrim)

EGR mass flow estimate before the delay (e2m 177F +4 CHP_EGR_Flow_Before_Delay, 'EGR flow before delay is imposed', lb/min x 128; throttle_fuel_trim_t_0040a3ea.final_trim). Runs the model that rpm_fuel_trim_select_cal chooses (e2m 177E +A C_CHP_Venturi_Vrt_Sensor_Active, 'select Upstream (0) or Downstream (1) EGR Flow Model'): 0 -> cm848_calculateRpmBasedFuelTrim (upstream, rpm_based_trim) and engine_fuel_fault_status from cm848_checkEngineFaultConditions; nonzero -> cm848_calculateLoadBasedFuelTrim (downstream, load_based_trim) and engine_fuel_fault_status from cm848_checkFuelSystemFaultFlags. The flow is limited to egr_mass_flow_estimate_minimum .. egr_mass_flow_estimate_maximum (e2m 177E +4 C_CHP_EGR_Flow_Min / +2 C_CHP_EGR_Flow_Max) and forced to 0 while egr_valve_closed_flag is set. engine_fuel_fault_status is e2m 177F +18 EGR_Flow_Source (0 primary, 1 backup). Only caller cm848_throttleBasedFuelCalculation, which delays and filters the estimate into egr_mass_flow_delayed_filtered and divides it by the charge flow. (was cm848_selectFuelTrimMode)

Calculates the engine volumetric efficiency model (e2m 177D, C_CHP_Veff_* constants in e2m 177C): engine_volumetric_efficiency (+0 CHP_Volumetric_Efficiency, Q13) plus its terms in boost_pressure_state_t_0040a406: rpm_modifier = +4 CHP_Veff_Mach (table of engine speed x boost_rpm_scale_factor_cal = e2m 177C +6 C_CHP_Veff_Stroke), lookup_result = +6 CHP_Veff_Sqrt (table of load_input, the intake manifold temperature in degrees Rankine = e2m 177D +2), computed_value = +8 CHP_Flow_Area_Constant (bore squared over valve diameter squared x 1024, limited to 0x5000; boost_pressure_factor_cal / boost_pressure_divisor_cal = e2m 177C +A C_CHP_Veff_Bore / +C C_CHP_Veff_Valve_Diameter) and pressure_ratio = +A CHP_Pratio (boost_pressure_current_raw = e2m 1A5D +0 Exhaust_Press, x 1024 over map_fuel_correction_factor = Charge_Press, limited to 0x1400 = 5.0). The efficiency is boost_pressure_upper_limit_cal (e2m 177C +16 C_CHP_Veff_Parameter_C) minus the smaller of that and (pressure_ratio + boost_pressure_offset_cal (+14 Parameter_B)) x -boost_map_correction_factor_cal (+12 Parameter_A) x rpm_modifier x computed_value / lookup_result, limited to fuel_demand_rpm_factor_base_cal .. fuel_demand_rpm_factor_upper_cal (e2m 177C +10 C_CHP_Veff_Min / +E C_CHP_Veff_Max). It reads engine speed and the globals directly: the two parameters in function_definitions.csv are never read (the disassembly overwrites r3 and r4 first). Caller cm848_fuelDemandWithLoadCompensation. (was cm848_boostBasedFuelModifier)

Charge mass flow by the speed density equation (e2m 191B +10 Charge_Flow virtual sensor, lb/min x 128; constants e2m 177C): engine speed x engine_volumetric_efficiency x map_fuel_correction_factor (e2m 1A2D +0 Charge_Press) x engine_displacement_cubic_inches (e2m 177C +8 C_CHP_Engine_Displacement) / (boost_pressure_state_t_0040a406.load_input x 0xa200) >> 10, where load_input is the intake manifold temperature in degrees Rankine (e2m 177D +2 CHP_Intake_Manifold_Tmptr_R). The result is limited to boost_load_lower_limit_cal .. fuel_quantity_ema_upper_limit_cal (e2m 177C +4 C_CHP_Charge_Flow_Min / +2 C_CHP_Charge_Flow_Max) and filtered by exponentialMovingAverage (state boost_modifier_filter_state, coefficient boost_modifier_filter_coefficient = e2m 177C +0 C_CHP_Charge_Flow_Fil_Cnst) into charge_mass_flow_filtered, the divisor of the EGR fraction in cm848_throttleBasedFuelCalculation. Caller cm848_fuelDemandWithLoadCompensation. (was cm848_loadBasedFuelAdjustment)

Pumping torque (e2m 1781): looks up the nominal engine delta pressure of the engine speed x total_injection_quantity_for_air_handling grid (e2m 1954 C_CHP_Nominal_Delta_P_Table) into fuel_demand_blend_lookup (+0 CHP_Nominal_Engine_Delta_P), subtracts the actual engine delta pressure egr_delta_pressure_negated (e2m 1A19 +8 Engine_Delta_Press), applies the deadband fuel_demand_deadband_cal (e2m 1780 +8 C_CHP_Pump_Torque_Deadband), converts the difference to torque with engine_displacement_cubic_inches and fuel_demand_percent_scale_cal (e2m 1780 +4 C_CHP_Pump_Torque_Multiplier) and limits it to +-8000 into fuel_demand_blend_intermediate (+4 CHP_Pumping_Torque_No_Offset). The same torque plus fuel_demand_blend_offset_cal (e2m 1780 +6 C_CHP_Pump_Torque_Offset), set to 0 while total_injection_quantity_for_air_handling is below fuel_demand_load_threshold_cal (e2m 1780 +A C_CHP_Pump_Torque_Min_Fuel) and limited to fuel_demand_min_limit_cal .. fuel_demand_blend_upper_cal (e2m 1780 +2 / +0 C_CHP_Pumping_Torque_Min / _Max), is pumping_torque_adjustment (+2 CHP_Pumping_Torque_Adj), the term between net and gross torque. It reads engine speed and the globals directly: the two parameters in function_definitions.csv are never read (r3 and r4 are overwritten first). Caller cm848_periodicTaskSet_controlLoop. (was cm848_calculateBoostPressureOffset)

Charge pressure in range fault counter (e2m 1A2D +A Charge_Press_IR_Fault_Cnt), run every pass by cm848_processBoostProtectionConditions after it sets Charge_Press_IR_Cond (boost_fuel_below_threshold_flag: 0 good, 1 suspect). With the monitor disabled (bit 0x10 of governor_feature_config_flags clear, or air_handling_compensation_and_diagnostic_bypass_cal nonzero) the count is 0. While Charge_Press_IR_Enable (boost_condition_active_flag, e2m 1A2D +8) is set it adds charge_pressure_in_range_fault_count_increment (e2m 1A2C +4 C_Charge_Press_Fault_Cnt_Incrt) per suspect pass, limited to charge_pressure_in_range_fault_set_threshold (+6 C_Charge_Press_Fault_Set), and subtracts fuel_demand_step_decrement_cal (+2 C_Charge_Press_Fault_Cnt_Decrt) per good pass down to 0. At or above the set threshold it sets fault bit 527 (fault_detected_bits_512_to_527 | 0x8000); at or below fuel_demand_step_min_threshold_cal (+0 C_Charge_Press_Fault_Clear) it clears the detected and registered bit. Fault 527 has no P-code (ROM 0x5985a slot 170, no obd_dtc_code_table entry). (was cm848_processBoostControlState)

Lead compensation of the intake manifold temperature sensor lag (sensor channel 9, e2m 18D9): intake_manifold_temperature_lead_term (+2 TPE_IMT_Lead_Term) = intake_manifold_temperature_lead_time_constant (+4 TPE_IMT_Lead_Time_Constant) x (sensor_channel9_pressure_value minus its previous value sensor_channel9_pressure_snapshot), limited to +-32000; intake_manifold_temperature_after_lead (+0 TPE_IMT_After_Lead) = the sensor value plus the lead term, limited to pressure_sensor_lower_limit_cal .. injection_timing_offset_floor_cal (e2m 18D6 +2 C_TPE_Min_IMT / +4 C_TPE_Max_IMT, 1/64 degree F per count). Then it stores the sensor value as the new snapshot. Same algorithm as the EGR orifice temperature lead function (sensor_channel108_filter). Caller cm848_calculatePressureSensorFiltered. (was cm848_calculatePressureSensorDerivative)

Intake manifold temperature (e2m 18D9 +8 Charge_Tmptr, 1/64 degree F; +A Charge_Tmptr_Source; +C Charge_Tmptr_State): looks up the lead time constant from charge_mass_flow_filtered (cold_start_pressure_scale_working from fuel_quantity_ema_axis_cal / fuel_quantity_ema_output_cal = e2m 18D7 C_TPE_IMT_Lead_Mass_Flow_Axis / 18D8 C_TPE_IMT_Lead_Time_Cnst_Table; 0 when sensor_channel9_fault_status or air_handling_compensation_and_diagnostic_bypass_cal is nonzero or bit 0x4000 of algorithm_enable_flags_20_cal is clear), runs cm848_calculatePressureSensorDerivative (the lead compensation) and filters intake_manifold_temperature_after_lead with two cascaded cm848_signedFirstOrderFilter stages (pressure_correction_first_filter / pressure_correction_second_filter, coefficient e2m 18D6 +0 C_TPE_IMT_Lag_Filter_Constant), but only with the compensation on (sensor status 0, bypass cal 0 and mask 0x4000 of algorithm_enable_flags_20_cal set); otherwise intake_manifold_temperature_after_lead passes through unfiltered. It builds fuel_demand_phase_status_flags (Charge_Tmptr_State) from injection_enable_mode_byte (e2m 1A1B +4 Charge_Tmptr_EStat, the quality of the charge temperature estimate: cm848_processBoostProtectionMode sets 0x80 when the compressor inlet temperature source is default or the estimate is disabled, 0x40 when it is backup), the sensor channel 9 fault status and the gated sensor faults (fault bits 19 / 20 = P0113 / P0112, 354 / 358 = P0111, through ROM 0x5985a and obd_dtc_code_table), and selects the source into fuel_demand_phase_state (Charge_Tmptr_Source): 0 primary = the filtered value, 1 backup = fuel_demand_boost_offset_filtered (e2m 1A1B +0 Charge_Tmptr_Est), 2 default = sensor_channel9_pressure_default_value (e2m 1966 +1E Charge_Tmptr_Default; only when a sensor fault is set and the estimate is unusable). The selected value is intake_manifold_temperature_filtered (Charge_Tmptr). Caller cm848_phase_group_b_processing. (was cm848_calculatePressureSensorFiltered)

EGR delta pressures (e2m 1A19). egr_flow_cold_side_algorithm_select (e2m 177E +8 C_CHP_Downstream_Delta_P_Active: 0 = hot side, nonzero = cold side algorithm; not the model select rpm_fuel_trim_select_cal) = 0: egr_delta_pressure (+4 EGR_Valve_Delta_Press) is the sensor output egr_delta_pressure_sensor_output (channel 105 after the autozero), egr_orifice_delta_pressure (+0 EGR_Orifice_Delta_Press) is 0 with its source boost_fuel_mode_state (+2) = 2 (default), and the engine delta pressure source fuel_demand_enable_state_cached (+A Engine_Delta_Press_Source) is egr_delta_pressure_sensor_source. Nonzero: egr_delta_pressure = (boost_pressure_current_raw (e2m 1A5D +0 Exhaust_Press) - boost_pressure_baseline_cal) - map_fuel_correction_factor (Charge_Press), egr_orifice_delta_pressure is the sensor output (boost_fuel_mode_state = its source), and the computed source is 2 when the exhaust and charge pressure sources (fuel_demand_droop_state, fuel_demand_mode_index) are both 2, 0 when both are 0, else 1. Then egr_delta_pressure_negated = -egr_delta_pressure (+8 Engine_Delta_Press) and egr_delta_pressure_source (+6 EGR_Valve_Delta_Press_Source) = the engine delta pressure source. Caller cm848_phase_group_a_processing. (was cm848_calculateFuelFlowWithMode)

Lead compensation of the EGR orifice temperature sensor lag (sensor channel 108 = e2m 1966 +14 EGR_Orifice_Tmptr_Sensor; e2m 19CA): egr_orifice_temperature_lead_term (+8 INM_EGRT_Lead_Term) = egr_orifice_temperature_lead_time_constant (+A INM_EGRT_Lead_Time_Constant) x (sensor_channel108_value minus its previous value, the word at 0x3fbcfa), limited to +-32000; egr_orifice_temperature_after_lead (+6 INM_EGRT_After_Lead) = the sensor value plus the lead term, limited to throttle_trim_predictor_output_min .. egr_orifice_temperature_estimate_maximum_limit (e2m 1A2E +4 C_INM_EGRT_Min / +2 C_INM_EGRT_Max, 1/64 degree F per count). Then it stores the sensor value as the new previous value. Same algorithm as the intake manifold temperature lead function (cm848_calculatePressureSensorDerivative). Caller sensor_throttleTrim_ema_faultProcess. (was sensor_channel108_filter)

Filters the EGR orifice temperature (e2m 19CA, sensor channel 108): sets egr_orifice_temperature_state (+4 EGR_Orifice_Tmptr_State) to sensor_channel108_fault_status (e2m 1963 +12 EGR_Orifice_Tmptr_Status), or to 0 when egr_flow_cold_side_algorithm_select (e2m 177E +8, 0 = hot side algorithm) is 0 because the orifice temperature is unused there. Looks up the lead time constant from egr_mass_flow_delayed_filtered (tables e2m 1A2F C_INM_EGRT_Lead_EGR_Flow_Axis / 1A30 C_INM_EGRT_Lead_Time_Cnst_Table) into throttle_trim_predictor_gain_lookup and uses it as egr_orifice_temperature_lead_time_constant unless the sensor status is nonzero, air_handling_compensation_and_diagnostic_bypass_cal is nonzero or bit 0x8000 of algorithm_enable_flags_20_cal is clear (then 0). Runs sensor_channel108_filter (the lead compensation), then two cascaded exponentialMovingAverage filters (states at 0x3fbd00 / 0x3fbd08) over egr_orifice_temperature_after_lead into the filtered temperature at 0x3fbcf6, the primary value that sensor_throttleTrim_inputSelect selects; with the compensation off it stores egr_orifice_temperature_after_lead unfiltered. Caller cm848_phase_groupB_calculation_2. (was sensor_throttleTrim_ema_faultProcess)

Selects the EGR orifice temperature (e2m 19CA +0 EGR_Orifice_Tmptr, 1/64 degree F) and its source (+2 EGR_Orifice_Tmptr_Source: 0 primary, 2 default): when mask 0x02 of egr_orifice_temperature_state (the sensor channel 108 fault status 2, confirmed) is clear it takes the filtered temperature at 0x3fbcf6 and source 0, otherwise sensor_channel108_default_value (e2m 1966 +2C EGR_Orifice_Tmptr_Default) and source 2. Called after sensor_throttleTrim_ema_faultProcess by cm848_phase_groupB_calculation_2. (was sensor_throttleTrim_inputSelect)

Learns the accelerator pedal minimum Throttle_Min (e2m 1047 +A, fuel_demand_control_t.throttle_based) and the autozero (e2m 101A +0 Auto_Zero, accelerator_pedal_autozero_cal, EEPROM 0x928). Learning runs only while switch 7 (accelerator at idle, switch_input_state_bits[0] mask 0x80) is on and switch 8 (off idle, [1] mask 0x01) is off, fuel_demand_override_counter is not above the time limit (e2m 1048 +18 TPS_AZ_Time_Limit, ROM 0x5c2a6) and the accepted update count governor_speed_output_snapshot is not above accelerator_pedal_autozero_update_count_limit (e2m 1048 +1A TPS_AZ_Update_Limit); otherwise throttle_fuel_demand_tracked follows throttle_based and the confidence counter fuel_demand_control_t.rate_delta (e2m 1047 +8 Current_Confidence_Counter) is 0. While learning it tracks the lowest accelerator_pedal_sensor_counts: a reading below throttle_based becomes the candidate and loads the counter with accelerator_pedal_minimum_learning_confidence_count_limit (e2m 1048 +8 Maximum_Confidence_Count); readings within accelerator_pedal_minimum_learning_confidence_band (+A Confidence_Band) of the candidate count it down and at 0 the candidate becomes throttle_based, accelerator_pedal_autozero_cal = candidate + fuel_demand_cal_offset (+10 Auto_Zero_Offset) is stored and the update count is incremented; readings above the band count it back up, and reaching the count limit drops the candidate. When throttle_based is at or above throttle_fuel_demand_threshold_cal (+6 Highest_Throttle_Min) and an update was accepted, it is set back to accelerator_pedal_autozero_cal - fuel_demand_cal_offset. Caller cm848_fuelDemandCoordinator. (was cm848_fuelDemandOverrideHandler)

User fueling state FOUR_D: while engine_operating_mode is FUELING_STATE_DUAL_AXIS_FUEL_DEMAND_TABLE (e2m label FOUR_D, code 8) it stores the result of cm848_calculateDualAxisFuelLimit in four_dimensional_fueling (e2m 1053 +0 Four_D_Fueling, '[_5DFL] fueling value calculated from the 4D fueling tables') and copies it to engine_operating_mode_fuel_demand (e2m 1050 +0 User_Fueling). Does nothing in the other modes. Caller cm848_periodicTaskSet_sensorProcessing. (was cm848_updateEngineTimingCompensation)

Filters the commanded throttle for the 4-D fueling (e2m 1053): the error fuel_demand_control_t.calculated (e2m 1047 +0 Commanded_Throttle) minus commanded_throttle_filtered goes, as an absolute value, through the table fuel_mode_ema_axis_cal / fuel_mode_ema_output_cal into fuel_mode_ema_output, the candidate filter constant. fuel_limit_mode_flags holds the e2m 1053 +A flags (mask 0x01 Throttle_Decrease_Flag, mask 0x02 Throttle_Transient_Flag): a drop of the candidate starts a transient (mask 0x01 also set when the error is negative, i.e. the throttle is decreasing) and it ends when the error comes back to the ROM threshold DAT_0005c30e (at or below it while increasing, above its negative while decreasing). commanded_throttle_filter_coefficient (+6 Active_Throttle_Filter_Constant) follows the candidate, but during a transient it only follows a lower one. exponentialMovingAverage (state fuel_mode_filter_state, whose coefficient is that word) then filters the commanded throttle into commanded_throttle_filtered (+8 Filtered_Commanded_Throttle), the throttle input of the 4-D fueling tables. Caller hpcr_periodicTaskSet_fuelFinal. (was cm848_calculateFuelDemandChangeRate)

Throttle 100 percent fuelings (e2m 105A; throttle 400 = 100 percent). With algorithm_enable_flags_18_cal.programmable_power_enable = 0 it stores throttle_100_fueling (+0 Throttle_100_Fueling) = cm848_calculateMaximumFuelCurve at the engine speed and throttle 400, throttle_100_fueling_low_horsepower_curve (+2 Tau_0_Throttle_100_Fueling, the fuel_demand_rpm_threshold_cal / fuel_demand_rpm_limit_*_cal grid at throttle 400), engine_speed_limit_ramped_maximum_fuel_quantity (+4 Throttle_100_Fuel_At_HSG_Bef_Droop_Speed) and engine_speed_limit_reference_maximum_fuel_quantity (+6 Throttle_100_Fuel_At_HSG_Bkpt_Speed), the last two from cm848_lookupChiMaximumFuelAtSpeed at engine_speed_limit_ramped / engine_speed_limit_reference; each gets fuel_demand_offset_correction added when mask 0x1000 of algorithm_enable_flags_41_cal (reserved_bit_12) is set, the first two are raised to at least fuel_demand_minimum and the low horsepower one is limited to the valid range. throttle_100_fueling_without_programmable_power (+8 Throttle_100_Fueling_No_PP) is always calculated like throttle_100_fueling, with thermal_fuel_limit_factor (the alpha, e2m 1053 +2 Fuel_Interp_Factor) forced to 0 while bit 0x10 of algorithm_enable_flags_12_cal (ESP enable) is set. Caller cm848_periodicTaskSet_controlLoop. (was cm848_calculateFuelDemandWithTrim)

No load fuel (e2m 109C +0 No_Load_Fuel, '[NLFL] fuel required to overcome friction', fuel_demand_base_offset at 0x40aeec) and its terms (e2m 109C): friction_fuel_adjustment_for_coolant_temperature (+4 Coolant_Fuel_Adjustment, table of the coolant temperature), friction_fuel_adjustment_for_air_conditioning_clutch (+8 AC_Fuel_Adjustment, table of engine speed; 0 unless bit 0x40 of air_conditioning_clutch_request_byte is set and the A/C fault bits fault_detected_bits_368_to_383 0x8 / 0x10 are clear), friction_fuel_adjustment_for_radiator_fan (+A Fan_Fuel_Adjustment, grid of radiator_fan_speed and engine speed) and friction_fueling (+6 Friction_Fueling, table of engine speed). fuel_demand_base_offset is the sum of the four. Caller cm848_periodicTaskGroup31_calibration13. (was governor_computeSpeedTargetWithThermalCorrection)

Engine torque terms (e2m 175C), all from the engine speed x fuel quantity torque map combustion_torque_by_fuel_quantity (the map of cm848_calculateNetCombustionTorque): friction_torque_adjustment_for_coolant_temperature (+8 Coolant_Torque_Adjustment) = the torque at friction_fuel_adjustment_for_coolant_temperature; engine_zero_fuel_base_friction_torque (+2 Zero_Fuel_Torque) = the torque at friction_fueling; engine_friction_torque (+0 Friction_Torque) = the first minus the second; engine_no_load_torque (+4 No_Load_Torque) = engine_friction_torque + pumping_torque_adjustment; net_combustion_torque_copy (+A Net_Engine_Torque) = a copy of net_combustion_torque; net_machine_torque (+6 Net_Machine_Torque) = that copy minus the torque at friction_fuel_adjustment_for_air_conditioning_clutch + friction_fuel_adjustment_for_radiator_fan + low_speed_governor_alternator_load_fuel (not below 0), the torque left after the A/C, fan and alternator loads. The fuels are the e2m 109C words written by governor_computeSpeedTargetWithThermalCorrection. Caller cm848_periodicTaskSet_sensorProcessing. (was cm848_applyProtectionRpmCorrectionFilter)

Ambient and compressor inlet conditions (e2m 1921). Filters the fresh air flow (boost_pressure_state_t_0040a406.fresh_air_mass_flow_filtered, e2m 177B +0 Fresh_Air_Flow) and looks up compressor_inlet_temperature_rise (+10 Compressor_Inlet_Tmptr_Rise) in a table of it and vehicle_speed_copy. ambient_air_temperature_reference (+6 Ambient_Air_Tmptr) = ambient_air_temperature_selected minus that rise, filtered by cm848_signedFirstOrderFilter, or ambient_air_temperature_override_value when ambient_air_temperature_user_override_enable_cal is set, or ambient_air_temperature_default_value when its source fuel_demand_timing_mode_state (+8 Ambient_Air_Tmptr_Source: the larger of fuel_demand_state_b = e2m 1A0C +2 Compressor_Inlet_Tmptr_Source and the fresh air flow source, 0 primary / 1 backup / 2 default) is 2. Looks up the inlet pressure drop boost_fuel_pressure_offset_lookup (+E Compressor_Inlet_Pressure_Drop) from the filtered fresh air flow, then barometric_pressure_reference (+2 Ambient_Air_Press) and compressor_inlet_pressure (+A Compressor_Inlet_Press) from barometric_pressure_selected: with barometric_pressure_sensor_senses_ambient_air_flag_cal clear the reference is the pressure plus the drop and the inlet pressure is the pressure; set, the reference is the pressure and the inlet pressure is the pressure minus the drop (at least 1). The pressure sources go to boost_pressure_fuel_mode_state (+4 Ambient_Air_Press_Source), fuel_demand_mode_state (+C Compressor_Inlet_Press_Source) and DAT_0040a1a6 (+12 Altitude_Source). Then barometric_altitude_feet (+0 Altitude) from barometric_pressure_reference (limited to 0x75e) through the altitude table and ambient_relative_humidity (+14 Ambient_Relative_Humidity) from a grid of engine speed and injection_quantity_combustion_reference. Caller hpcr_periodicTaskSet_fuelFinal. (was hpcr_fuelFinal_exponentialAverage)

Exhaust temperature estimate (e2m 17A1). The model is invalid (exhaust_temperature_model_invalid_flag, +6 TPE_Invalid_Model = 1, 'protect against divide by zero') while the engine speed is below 8 (1 rpm) or charge_fuel_ratio is below 128. Otherwise it calls cm848_calculateCombustionTemperatureRise for exhaust_temperature_model_delta (+0 Temperature_Delta); exhaust_temperature_rise_over_intake_manifold_temperature (+2 TPE_Delta_Exhaust_Tmptr) is that delta, or 0 when invalid. exhaust_temperature (+8 Exhaust_Tmptr, 0.5 degree F per count) = intake_manifold_temperature_filtered x 2 / 64 plus the rise, not below 0, and its copy is exhaust_temperature_virtual_sensor_copy (e2m 191B +14). exhaust_metal_temperature (+C Exhaust_Metal_Tmptr) = exponentialMovingAverage of it (state at 0x3fbcea). exhaust_temperature_source (+A Exhaust_Tmptr_Source) is 0 (primary) only when the charge flow, charge pressure and intake manifold temperature sources (boost_pressure_state_t_0040a406.reserved_0a, fuel_demand_mode_index, fuel_demand_phase_state) are all 0 and the model is valid, else 1 (backup). Caller cm848_periodicTaskSet_auxiliaryControl. (was cm848_auxiliaryControl_exponentialAverage)

Water vapor model of the intake charge and the exhaust (e2m 1982, the input of the condensation protection): ambient_saturation_vapor_pressure (+E TPE_Saturation_Vapor_Press) from ambient_air_temperature_reference through water_saturation_vapor_pressure_by_temperature_axis / _values; ambient_water_vapor_partial_pressure (+10 TPE_Vapor_Partial_Press) = it x ambient_relative_humidity (e2m 1921 +14) >> 10; inlet_water_vapor_fraction (+4 TPE_Inlet_H2O_Mole_Fraction) = that over barometric_pressure_reference, limited to 4096. charge_water_vapor_fraction (+0 TPE_Charge_H2O_Mole_Fraction) and exhaust_water_vapor_fraction (+2 TPE_Exhaust_H2O_Mole_Fraction) add the water that burning makes (from fuel_air_equivalence_ratio) to the inlet fraction; the charge one carries the part that the EGR returns, weighted by the larger of egr_fraction_combustion_reference_at_base_chi and egr_fraction_actual. charge_water_vapor_partial_pressure_times_4 (+6 Charge_H2O_PP) and exhaust_water_vapor_partial_pressure_times_4 (+8 Exhaust_H2O_PP) multiply the fractions by map_fuel_correction_factor (the charge pressure), and charge_saturation_temperature / exhaust_saturation_temperature (the dew points) look those up in fuel_demand_compensation_target_by_pressure_axis / _values. The source flag fuel_demand_mode_active_flag (+A Charge_Saturation_Tmptr_Source, copied to 0x40af74) is 0 only when the charge pressure, ambient temperature and ambient pressure sources are all 0, else 1. Caller main_loop. (was cm848_blendBoostAndThrottleFuelDemand)

Percent peak torque x 256 (0x6400 = 100 percent) available at one engine speed, for the J1939 (Jcomm) engine configuration data of e2m block 10E2. param_1 is the engine speed (1/8 rpm), param_2 the friction fuel at that speed. It reads the fuel at 100 percent throttle (y = 400) at that speed from the maximum fuel grid (fuel_demand_threshold_interp_state, x axis fuel_demand_rpm_threshold_cal, y axis fuel_demand_rpm_limit_low_cal, grid fuel_demand_rpm_limit_high_cal), clamps it with cm848_clampFuelDemandToValidRange (0x1ec48), subtracts param_2 plus the coolant temperature friction correction throttle_demand_offset_cal_working, and divides by the peak fueling span j1939_peak_fueling_tau_0 (e2m 10DF +6 Jcomm_Pk_Fueling_Tau_0) minus j1939_friction_load_fueling_at_breakpoint_4 (10E2 +14) with cm848_signedDivisionWithSaturation. Returns the value that cm848_processThrottlePositionLookups (0x1820c) stores in the Jcomm_Prc_Pk_Trq_* words (10E2 +4 .. +C). No bl and no 32-bit pointer to that caller was found in either bank, and those words read 0 in the RAM dump. (was cm848_throttlePositionProcessing)

Looks up the friction (no load) fueling friction_fuel_by_engine_speed_values at five engine speeds for the J1939 (Jcomm) engine configuration data, e2m block 10E2 (MM3S, 0.0679 mm3 per count): the low speed governor idle reference speed (governor_output_t_0040aec2.idle_reference_speed) into throttle_torque_integrator_lookup (+E Jcomm_Frict_Load_at_Low_Idle), the rated speed j1939_rated_speed_tau_0 into throttle_cal_b4_lookup (+10 Jcomm_Frict_Load_at_Rated_RPM) and the speed breakpoints 3 / 4 / 5 (j1939_speed_breakpoint_3_tau_0 / _4_ / _5_, e2m 10DF +A / +C / +E) into throttle_cal_b6_lookup (+12), j1939_friction_load_fueling_at_breakpoint_4 (+14) and throttle_cal_ba_lookup (+16). Called by cm848_initFaultSeverityTables (0x1ea94) at start-up and by cm848_processThrottlePositionLookups (0x1820c). RAM dump (key on, engine stopped): 340 at the rated speed and 97 / 263 / 311 at breakpoints 3 / 4 / 5, which the ROM table gives at those speeds; 397 at idle, the first table value. (was cm848_faultSeverityEvaluation)

Calculates the J1939 (Jcomm) percent peak torque at five engine speeds, x 256, e2m block 10E2. It first stores the coolant temperature friction correction (friction_fuel_correction_by_coolant_temperature_values at sensor_readings_t_0040baf2.coolant_temp) in throttle_demand_offset_cal_working, refreshes the five friction fuels with cm848_faultSeverityEvaluation (0x1811c) and then runs cm848_throttlePositionProcessing (0x18070) for each speed with its friction fuel: the idle reference speed into throttle_position_from_integrator (+A Jcomm_Prc_Pk_Trq_at_Idle), the rated speed j1939_rated_speed_tau_0 into throttle_position_b4 (+C Jcomm_Prc_Pk_Trq_at_Rated_RPM) and the speed breakpoints 3 / 4 / 5 into throttle_position_b6 / throttle_position_b8 / throttle_position_ba (+4 / +6 / +8). No caller was found (no bl and no 32-bit pointer to it in either bank) and the six percent words read 0 in the RAM dump. (was cm848_processThrottlePositionLookups)

Calculates the J1939 (Jcomm) percent peak torque of the current operating point, e2m 10E2 +2 Jcomm_Percent_Peak_Torque (percent x 256, 'based on current engine speed and temperature'), into throttle_protection_load_ratio, and records the no load fuel fuel_demand_base_offset in fuel_demand_base_offset_snapshot (+0 Jcomm_No_Load_Torque). It looks up the friction fuel at the speed breakpoint 4 (friction_fuel_by_engine_speed_values at j1939_speed_breakpoint_4_tau_0) into j1939_friction_load_fueling_at_breakpoint_4 (+14) and divides (final_fueling - fuel_demand_base_offset_snapshot) x 0x6400 by j1939_peak_fueling_tau_0 (e2m 10DF +6) minus that friction fuel with cm848_signedDivisionWithSaturation. No caller was found (no bl and no 32-bit pointer to it in either bank) and its two result words read 0 in the RAM dump. (was cm848_calculateThrottleProtectionLimit)

Recomputes the J1939 (Jcomm) reference engine fueling j1939_reference_engine_fueling (e2m 1102 +1C Jcomm_Reference_Engine_Fueling, 'Determined Peak Engine Fueling', MM3S) when bit 11 of algorithm_enable_flags_41_cal is set (guessed e2m Torque_Normalization_Enable; set in this calibration): (injection_quantity_combustion_chi_maximum - friction_fueling) x 10000 / ((fuel_demand_filter_dimension x 13558) / reference_engine_torque_working). fuel_demand_filter_dimension is the maximum torque in lb-ft at the current engine speed (e2m MT_Max_Torque_Map, cm848_calculateFuelDemandFilter at 0x29c98); x 13558 / 10000 turns it into N*m, so the net full load fuel is scaled by the reference engine torque (e2m 1102 +1E, 850 N*m) over that torque. RAM dump (key on, engine stopped): (1030 - 397) x 10000 / ((290 x 13558) / 850) = 1368 = j1939_reference_engine_fueling, against 1501 = j1939_peak_fueling (ROM, e2m 1104 +0) that cm848_initProtectionDelayDefaults (0x212dc) loads. Called from cm848_periodicTaskSet_sensorProcessing. (was cm848_calculateProtectionActivationDelay)

Calculates the actual engine percent torque x 256, actual_engine_percent_torque_times_256 (e2m 1102 +0 Jcomm_Actual_Engine_Ind_Torque, 'calculated output torque of the engine'): 0 when final_fueling equals the zero torque fueling fuel_demand_norm_zero_cal (ROM 0x5c398, e2m 10E7 +16 FSS_Zero_Torque_Fueling), otherwise (final_fueling - zero) x 0x6400 / (j1939_reference_engine_fueling - zero), clamped to 32000 and -32000 (plus or minus 125 percent x 256) by cm848_clampedDivisionWithBounds. Its high byte plus 125 is the EEC1 actual engine percent torque (SPN 513) in j1939GetEngineStateCode (0x2588c); cm848_runEmissionManager calls it too. (was cm848_calculateLoadRateOfChange)

Calculates the engine percent load at current speed x 256, j1939_engine_percent_load_at_current_speed_times_256 (e2m 1102 +4 Jcomm_Ind_Percent_Load, 'ratio of actual engine torque to max torque at current speed'; SPN 92 of EEC2): (final_fueling - fuel_demand_norm_zero_cal) x 0x6400 / (throttle_100_fueling - fuel_demand_norm_zero_cal), i.e. the actual torque as a share of the torque of the 100 percent throttle fuel curve at the current speed (throttle_100_fueling, e2m 105A +0). The result is 0x8300 (-32000, minus 125 percent) when either fuel difference is below -31999 and is capped at 32000 (125 percent). Called by cm848_buildPgn61443ElectronicEngineController2Message (0x25b10), whose byte 3 is the high byte. (was cm848_calculateLoadToFuelRatio)

Sets points 2 and 5 of the J1939 (Jcomm) torque curve of the engine configuration message from one fueling on the engine speed limit droop line. The fueling arrives in r3 (decompiled as the pointer parameter rx_msg) and a flag in r4. The speed is the droop line speed at that fueling: engine_speed_limit_arbitrated + engine_speed_limit_droop_slope x (((engine_speed_limit_ramped_maximum_fuel_quantity - fueling) x 8) & 0xfff8) / 0x8888, capped at 40000 (5000 rpm), or torque_limit_working_reference when engine_speed_limit_droop_slope is 0. It stores that speed in j1939_torque_curve_speed_at_point_2 (e2m 1102 +24 Jcomm_RPM_At_Point_2, the high speed governor breakpoint) and in j1939_torque_curve_speed_at_point_5 (+2A; with r4 = 0 point 5 gets the ROM speed protection_threshold_base_cal instead, e2m 1104 +8 Jcomm_Engine_Speed_at_Point_5) and the fueling in j1939_torque_curve_fueling_at_point_2 (+2E) and j1939_torque_curve_fueling_at_point_5 (+34). Its only caller cm848_updateProtectionStateMachine (0x20d10) passes j1939_derated_fueling_at_point_4 with r4 = 1 when ROM 0x5c35e (e2m 1104 +16 Jcomm_Tau_0_Point_5_Intersection_Speed) is above the speed limit, otherwise j1939_derated_fueling_at_point_5 with r4 = 0. It receives no J1939 message. (was cm848_processJ1939RxMessage)

Builds the J1939 (Jcomm) engine configuration torque curve of PGN 65251, e2m block 1102: the speeds, fuelings and indicated percent torques at points 1-5. A mode index is formed from the situation: +4 when governor_speed_limit_output is outside the low speed governor idle band (governor_output_t_0040aec2.idle_reference_speed plus or minus low_speed_governor_reference_speed_delta), +2 for an altitude derate or an air fuel control derate with a fault in bits 8 / 9 of fault_detected_bits_0_to_15 (torque_derate_fuel_source_code), +1 when the engine speed limit source (engine_speed_limit_arbitration.limiting_source_number) is 1 / 2 / 4 / 5 / 12. Its cases load the point speeds and fuelings from the derated ROM values (e2m 1104 Jcomm_Engine_Speed_at_Point_3-5, Jcomm_Derated_Fueling_at_Idle-Point_5 and the tau 0 / tau 1 derated point 2, chosen by thermal_fuel_limit_factor) with cm848_updateProtectionParameters (0x20b84), cm848_updateProtectionInputs (0x20bfc) and cm848_processJ1939RxMessage (0x20c64). Each percent torque is (fueling at the point - fuel_demand_norm_zero_cal) x 0x6400 / (reference fueling at the point - zero) clamped to plus or minus 32000, with the reference fuelings governor_speed_ref_channel_a..e (+40 .. +48), into j1939_indicated_percent_torque_at_idle_times_256, _point_2_, protection_speed_ratio_c, protection_speed_ratio_d and _point_5_ (+8 .. +10). It caches the determined speeds (+12 .. +1A) and the calculated fuelings (Jcomm_Calc_Fueling_At_Point_1-5, +36 .. +3E) and then resets the working fuelings to fuel_demand_maximum, which cm848_updateProtectionDiagnostics (0x21cd4) lowers again. Called by faultTimerHandler (0x1b3a0) before each PGN 65251 payload is filled. (was cm848_updateProtectionStateMachine)

Initializes the J1939 (Jcomm) reference values of the engine configuration message from the ROM: while the algorithm flag programmable_power_enable (algorithm_enable_flags_18_cal) is 0 it copies the peak fueling j1939_peak_fueling (e2m 1104 +0 Jcomm_Peak_Fueling, 1501 in the ROM = 102.0 mm3) into j1939_reference_engine_fueling (e2m 1102 +1C) and the reference engine torque j1939_reference_engine_torque (1104 +2 Jcomm_Reference_Engine_Torque, 850 N*m) into reference_engine_torque_working (1102 +1E). Called by initFaultTimerMessage (0x1b900), the PGN 65251 initialization; cm848_calculateProtectionActivationDelay (0x20500) recomputes the fueling afterwards when torque normalization is on. (was cm848_initProtectionDelayDefaults)

Returns the maximum engine torque in lb-ft at the engine speed param_1 (1/8 rpm): the e2m MT_Max_Torque_Map (Table with max torque corresp. to MTTQMPXA values; engine speed axis 140E MT_RPM_Axis x alpha axis 1447 MT_Alpha_Axis, 600 lb-ft at its peak in the ROM grid). The ROM rows named j1939_fuel_table_xaxis_cal / j1939_fuel_table_ystart_cal / j1939_fuel_table_yend_cal (0x5c556 / 0x5c582 / 0x5c58e) are this torque map, not a fuel table. It looks the grid up with fresh cache words at the alpha 0 row and at the two chi map rows combustion_chi_lower_map_number / combustion_chi_upper_map_number (x 0x4000) and blends them with cm848_interpolateAlphaChiValue (0x14528) by the chi and alpha of combustion_reference_state, as cm848_lookupChiMaximumFuelAtSpeed (0x164e4) does for the maximum fuel. cm848_calculateFuelDemandFilter (0x29c98) does the same at the current engine speed into fuel_demand_filter_dimension. Called by cm848_updateProtectionDiagnostics (0x21cd4) with the five torque curve speeds. (was cm848_initUdsServiceHandlers)

Sets the fueling points of the J1939 (Jcomm) torque curve and the reference fuelings that scale them into percent torque, e2m block 1102, for the throttle 100 request of PGN 65251. On first use protection_mode_request_bit = 1 << throttle_100_priority_bit_index (e2m 12BD +A Throttle_100_Priority). While programmable_power_enable is 0 it sets that bit in j1939_pgn65251_speed_points_request_flags, lets cm848_updateProtectionThresholdsIfLow (0x21c3c) write the point speeds from the broadcast overrides when no higher priority bit is set, and takes the maximum fuel of the chi curve at each of the five point speeds (cm848_lookupChiMaximumFuelAtSpeed, 0x164e4). The reference fuelings governor_speed_ref_channel_a..e (1102 +40 .. +48 Jcomm_Reference_Fueling_At_Point_1-5) are j1939_reference_engine_fueling at every point when torque normalization (algorithm_enable_flags_41_cal bit 11) is off, otherwise that maximum fuel divided by ((maximum torque at the point speed x 13558) / reference_engine_torque_working), the torque coming from cm848_initUdsServiceHandlers (0x21ac0). There is no x 10000 as in cm848_calculateProtectionActivationDelay (0x20500): the divisor is 3939 (247 lb-ft) to 9570 (600 lb-ft), so a fuel of about 1000 .. 2000 counts gives a quotient of 0, and all five words read 0 in the RAM dump. When the highest set request bit (cm848_getHighestPriorityBit, 0x21bf8) is in throttle_100_fueling_point_clamp_bitmap (e2m 12BD +8 Throttle_100_Min_Config), protection_cal_level1_working (point 1) and j1939_torque_curve_fueling_at_point_2 .. 5 (e2m 1102 +2C .. +34) are only lowered to the maximum fuel; otherwise they are replaced by it, unless a higher priority request bit is set. Called by cm848_periodicTaskSet_diagnostics2. (was cm848_updateProtectionDiagnostics)

Sends one test result of the non-continuously monitored systems, PGN 65232 (Test Results for Non-continuously Monitored Systems; transmit descriptor j1939_pgn65232_tx_message, 8 bytes, set by cm848_initJ1939EngineControlBuffer at 0x2560c). param_1 is the test identifier (SPN 1224, byte 1: 0 = the intake air heater monitor, 1 = the misfire monitor) and param_2 the 16-bit test value (SPN 1226, byte swapped with j1939_reverseByteOrder16 into bytes 3-4). The test type byte and the limit words keep their 0xff / 0xffff initial values (not available). The only caller is cm848_j1939HandlePgn58112Dm7 (0x227a0), the handler of the command for these tests (PGN 58112), which passes intake_air_heater_monitor_result for test 0 and misfire_monitor_result for test 1. (was cm848_j1939SendDm1ResponseMessage)

Runs the J1939 TSC1 lost management (the e2m TSC_Lost_* records, 10E7 +28 .. +30 and 11C1 +4): it hands the engine back to the accelerator pedal when a TSC1 control request has timed out. Called in three places of cm848_processGovernorModeTransition (0x2715c): with no override active (governor mode 0, etc1_speed_error_timeout below 2), when the activation confirm timer etc1_activation_confirm_timer expires (the sender then goes into the ignored request list with cm848_addEngineTsc1IgnoredRequestEntry) and when a request's etc1_speed_error_timeout runs out (modes 1 / 2 / 3). It keeps the governor mode in governor_mode_snapshot. While the accelerator pedal (fuel_demand_control_t_0040a57a.calculated, 400 = 100 percent) is above tsc1_lost_management_minimum_accelerator_pedal (TSC_Lost_Min_Throttle_Disable) and below etc1_fuel_demand_high_limit (11C1 +4 TSC_Lost_Max_Throttle_Disable) and etc1_speed_error_timeout_flag is 1, then, while fuel_demand_timing_enable_flag is 1, it adds tsc1_lost_torque_ramp_rate to etc1_torque_limit_integrator (the torque limit etc1_mode3_torque_limit is its value >> 6, at most 0xffff) and tsc1_lost_speed_ramp_rate to the speed limit j1939_tsc1_override_state.etc1_torque_limit_value, and sets governor mode 3. Outside those throttle limits it resets: etc1_mode3_torque_limit = tsc1_lost_reset_torque_limit (TSC_Lost_Reset_Torque; 0xffff, no limit, at or above the maximum throttle), governor mode 0, _j1939_governor_source_index 0, the integrator = limit << 6 and the speed limit = the current engine speed. It always clears etc1_control_flags, etc1_speed_error_timeout and etc1_activation_confirm_timer. The e2m TSC_Lost_Reset_Speed (10E7 +2A, ROM 0x5c3ac) is not read: no load of that word was found in the disassembly. It formats no DM1 message. (was cm848_j1939FormatDm1Message)

Files a finished J1939 control session in the J1939 history table (e2m 10FD J1939_History_Table: a length word 0x78 at 0x3fead4, then 5 entries of 24 bytes from 0x3fead6). param_1 selects the session record: 0 is the engine control (TSC1) record at 0x3feb50 (e2m 10FE J1939_Active_Engine), any other value the retarder control record at 0x3feb6a (10FF J1939_Active_Retarder). Its 12 words are copied into the history entry number j1939_history_table_next_entry_index_cal (e2m 1100 +8 J1939_History_Table_Next_Entry), and that index is incremented and wraps from 4 to 0. The destination is written as j1939_input_signal_timeouts + index x 12 + 24 words, which is the table at 0x3fead4 behind that 25 word array. Called by phase_group_a_setupETC1Controller (0x50bff4) when a control session ends or its source changes. (was governor_calibSnapshot_rollingBuffer_update)

Opens a J1939 control session record. param_1 = 0 starts an engine control (TSC1) session: j1939_engine_control_active_flag_cal = 1 (e2m 1100 +0 J1939_Engine_Control_Status), j1939_engine_control_source_index_cal (+4 J1939_Engine_Control_Source; 1 = transmission, 2 = ABS, 3 = ASR, 4 = unknown) takes _j1939_governor_source_index, and the active record at 0x3feb50 (e2m 10FE J1939_Active_Engine) gets kind 0, the controlling source address j1939_tsc1_override_state.etc1_spn1482_source_address, the source index, a mode history whose write index is 1 with j1939_tsc1_override_state.governor_mode as first entry and four cleared entries, and the start time key_on_hour_meter in etc1_governor_calib_session_start_time. Any other param_1 does the same for the retarder control session (record at 0x3feb6a, e2m 10FF J1939_Active_Retarder, kind 1; engine_retarder_controlling_source_address, engine_retarder_controlling_source_index, engine_retarder_override_control_mode, j1939_retarder_control_active_flag_cal, j1939_retarder_control_source_index_cal). Called by phase_group_a_setupETC1Controller (0x50bff4). (was governor_sourceData_init)

J1939 monitor (enabled by bit 0x800 of governor_feature_config_word, e2m 106B +6 J1939_Monitor_Enable; set in this calibration, 15888 = 0x3e10 in the RAM dump): tracks the sessions in which another device controls the engine or the retarder over J1939. It compares the engine control (TSC1) state j1939_tsc1_override_state.governor_mode / etc1_active_state / etc1_spn1482_source_address and the retarder control state engine_retarder_override_control_mode / engine_retarder_controlling_source_address with the values kept in the *_transition_snapshot words (etc1_governor_mode_transition_snapshot and so on). When a control starts it opens a session record (governor_sourceData_init at 0x50beec; e2m 10FE J1939_Active_Engine at 0x3feb50 and 10FF J1939_Active_Retarder at 0x3feb6a). While the same source keeps controlling it appends each new mode to the record's mode history of five entries (shifting it when full). When the control ends, or the controlling source changes, it stores the session duration (key_on_hour_meter minus the start time) in the record, clears the control active flag (e2m 1100 +0 / +2 J1939_Engine_Control_Status / J1939_Retarder_Control_Status) and files the record in the J1939 history table with governor_calibSnapshot_rollingBuffer_update (0x50be6c). Called by cm848_phase_group_a_processing (0xb7b4). (was phase_group_a_setupETC1Controller)

Stores one sample of the data collector in its ring buffer: the bytes at the addresses of the collector table (e2m 003B Collector_Table, up to 32 addresses at diag_dm1_fault_source_table, diag_dm1_active_fault_entry_count of them; an address at or above 0x01000000 reads as 0) go to consecutive buffer positions at the write pointer data_collector_end_address (e2m 0035 Collector_End_Address), which wraps from diag_dm1_buffer_end_ptr to diag_dm1_buffer_start_ptr. When the write pointer reaches the read pointer data_collector_start_address (e2m 0033 Collector_Start_Address) the oldest byte is overwritten (the read pointer moves on), except in stop mode 3 (diag_dm1_fill_mode_config, e2m Collector_Stop_Mode): there it sets the fill phase diag_dm1_buffer_fill_phase to 3, data_collector_trigger_active_cal to 1 and data_collector_status to 2 (full) and stops. The fill ends at diag_dm1_buffer_fill_end_ptr. Called by cm848_phase_groupB_calculation (0x505f98), the data collector pass. (was diag_dm1Buffer_circularFill)

Resets the data collector to its empty state: data_collector_status 0 (e2m 0036 Collector_Status: not collecting), data_collector_trigger_active_cal 0 (e2m 0039 Collector_Trigger), the buffer start pointer diag_dm1_buffer_start_ptr and the write and read pointers data_collector_end_address / data_collector_start_address (e2m 0035 / 0033) all at the buffer base 0x40c28a, data_collector_table_address (e2m 0037 Collector_Table_Address) at the collector address table diag_dm1_fault_source_table, the fill phase diag_dm1_buffer_fill_phase 0 and the entry count diag_dm1_active_fault_entry_count 0. Called by cm848_applicationMain (0x544c4) at start-up and by j1939_dm1_diagnosticMessage_send (0x505df0) when its transport protocol session does not end in state 5. (was hpcr_exception_process)

Sends the collected data of the data collector over J1939. It acts only in stop mode 3 (diag_dm1_fill_mode_config, e2m Collector_Stop_Mode) and while the read pointer data_collector_start_address differs from the write pointer data_collector_end_address. It counts the buffered bytes (cut to a whole number of samples that fit into 32 bytes, that is 32 / diag_dm1_active_fault_entry_count x that count), takes a transport buffer with j1939_selectResponseBuffer, sets its can_id to priority 6, PF 0xff, PS 0xff and j1939_source_address (a broadcast that initiateJ1939TransportProtocol announces with the transport protocol) and copies the bytes out of the ring buffer (clearing diag_dm1_buffer_slot_started_flag when the copy reaches the write pointer). Only when the transport session started (state 0x10, then the packets go out with j1939_transport_singleFrame_send while the state is 0x11) is the read pointer data_collector_start_address moved past the sent bytes; without a started session it stays where it was, and a session that does not end in state 5 resets the collector with hpcr_exception_process (0x505d94). Called at the end of every cm848_phase_groupB_calculation (0x505f98) pass. It is not a DM1 message. (was j1939_dm1_diagnosticMessage_send)

Runs one pass of the Cummins data collector (e2m records 002F .. 003B): a tool-controlled sampler of up to 32 addresses (the table e2m 003B Collector_Table at diag_dm1_fault_source_table) into a 32768 byte ring buffer, with an optional trigger. It sets the fill phase to 0 and returns unless the collector is enabled (governor_fault_status_flags bit 0x100, e2m 106B +2 Collector_Enable, 'EEPROM indicator set by tools to enable data collector operation'; clear in this calibration, 39954 = 0x9c12 in the RAM dump), and it runs only for the call selected by data_collector_schedule_cal (e2m 002F Collector_Schedule: 0 = cm848_phase_group_b_processing, 1 = hpcr_processEngineSyncPulses; param_1 is the call number). Every data_collector_multiple_cal passes (e2m 003A Collector_Multiple, a multiple of 20 ms) it reads the trigger input line data_collector_trigger_input_line_cal (e2m Data_Collector_Trigger_Map) with cm848_readDiscreteInputLine: an active line sets data_collector_trigger_active_cal (e2m 0039 Collector_Trigger) and counts data_collector_trigger_count_cal once per activation. Fill phase 0 counts the table entries, sizes the ring (diag_dm1_bytes_per_fault_slot = 0x8000 / entries, the buffer end and fill end pointers) and starts filling (phase 1, data_collector_status 1); phase 1 fills until the trigger and then continues as phase 2 by the stop mode (diag_dm1_fill_mode_config 1: half a buffer past data_collector_center_address, 2: from the buffer start to its end), phase 3 holds. The filling is diag_dm1Buffer_circularFill (0x505c20); every pass ends with j1939_dm1_diagnosticMessage_send (0x505df0). (was cm848_phase_groupB_calculation)

Formats an unsigned number as zero padded decimal ASCII text. param_1 points at the number (a 4-byte value), param_2 is the text buffer and param_3 the digit count: the digits are written backwards, the last one at param_2 + param_3 - 1 (the callers use 8). param_3 = 1 is a special mode: param_1 is read as 4 bytes and each byte is written as two decimal digits, 8 characters in all (for example the bytes 11 46 6 0 give 11460600). Used for the star delimited ID strings of the J1939 component identification (cm848_j1939HandlePgn65259ComponentId, 0x24870) and software identification (cm848_initPgn65242SoftwareIdHandler, 0x268ac), whose last number is application_overlay_core_software_version (e2m 0019 Calibration_Version_Number). It has nothing to do with a governor droop. (was cm848_governorDroopCalculation)

Engine protection restart examination (e2m 10B1 +10 Precrank_Shutdown, 'EPF shutdown engine command from restart examine before cranking'). While the engine is CRANKING and the feature bits are set (governor_feature_config_word, e2m 106B +6: 0x10 Engine_Protection_Enable, 0x1 Engine_Protection_Shutdown_Enable, 0x20 Engine_Protection_Restart_Enable) it looks at the channel that caused the last shutdown (governor_faultDerate_active_channel, 0xff = none, channel 4 excluded) once that channel's consecutive shutdown count governor_faultDerate_consecutive_count has reached the ROM limit DAT_0005c2f4 (e2m 10B9 +0 Shutdown_Max_Limit, 'max number of shutdowns before restart is not allowed') and its shutdown and restart enable bits are set in the per channel enable words (e2m 106B +12, EEPROM 0x12a: bits 130 + 4n and 131 + 4n). If a threshold of that channel is still exceeded (protection_threshold_check at 0x507ebc, for the thresholds selected by the masks 0x1 and 0x2 of the channel's configuration flags) it sets fuel_temperature_derate_precrank_error_flag for the channel (e2m 1152 +18 Fuel_Temperature_Precrank_Error) and engine_protection_precrank_shutdown_command_flag, which governor_faultDerate_mainLoop_update (0x508898) turns into engine_shutdown_command_flag. Called on every pass by cm848_runFaultDerateScheduler (0x507c44). The shutdown enable bit is clear in this calibration (15888 = 0x3e10 in governor_feature_config_word), so it does nothing here. (was governor_coldStart_faultDerate_trigger)

Engine protection shutdown algorithm (e2m blocks 10B1 and 1152; enabled by bit 0 of governor_feature_config_word, e2m 106B +6 Engine_Protection_Shutdown_Enable, clear in this calibration: 15888 = 0x3e10 in the RAM dump): the last of the five tasks of cm848_runFaultDerateScheduler (0x507c44). With the engine STOPPED it clears governor_faultDerate_latch; with the shutdown disabled, or in SHUTDOWN or STOPPED, it clears engine_protection_shutdown_approaching_flag, the two shutdown time counts (fuel_temperature_derate_fuel_shutdown_time_count / _rpm_) and the override latch governor_fuel_derate_j1939_latch. Otherwise, unless the latch governor_faultDerate_latch is set, it goes through the channels whose shutdown enable bit is set (bit 130 + 4n of the e2m 106B +12 enable words): it counts the time over each of the channel's two thresholds (protection_event_timestamp, 0x508834; e2m 1152 +1A / +1C), keeps the longest in governor_faultDerate_peak_value, sets engine_protection_shutdown_approaching_flag (e2m 10B1 +14 Shutdown_Approaching) when a time passes its start warning time, and sets engine_shutdown_command_flag (10B1 +12 Shutdown, 'turn off all solenoids') when it passes the warning time plus the channel's shutdown delay, recording the channel in governor_faultDerate_active_channel. An override request (the latch governor_fuel_derate_j1939_latch) sets the time back to the warning time and starts the override lamp flag at 0x40a78b (e2m 10B1 +19 EPF_Shutdown_Override_Lamp_Flag). The restart results engine_protection_precrank_shutdown_command_flag and governor_faultDerate_engine_sync_trigger (10B1 +0 Restart_Oil_Pressure_Shutdown) also force the shutdown. Each shutdown increments governor_faultDerate_total_event_count and, for the same channel, governor_faultDerate_consecutive_count, and is held in governor_faultDerate_latch. It ends by setting governor_fuel_derate_state (e2m 10B1 +1E J1939_EP_Timer_State): 3 when the shutdown is disabled, 1 while a timer runs or the approach flag is set, otherwise 0. (was governor_faultDerate_mainLoop_update)

Detects an engine protection shutdown override request (e2m 10B1 +18 EPF_Shutdown_Override_Flag, 'EPS shutdown override request detected'): when the override algorithm is enabled (bit 0x200 of j1939_feature_enable_flags_cal, e2m 106B +3C EPF_Shutdown_Override_Enable), engine_protection_shutdown_approaching_flag is set and logical switch 31 (switch_input_state_bits[3] bit 0x80) turns on (a rising edge against governor_derate_j1939_protection_active_prev) it sets governor_derate_j1939_trigger_pending. The previous switch state is saved on every call. governor_derateTrigger_latch_clear (0x508ee0) turns the pending request into the override latch. It receives no J1939 message. Called from cm848_periodicTaskSet_auxiliaryControl. (was cm848_updateJ1939ReceptionControlFlag)

Turns a pending engine protection shutdown override request into the override latch: when governor_derate_j1939_trigger_pending (set by cm848_updateJ1939ReceptionControlFlag at 0x508e78) is non-zero it sets governor_fuel_derate_j1939_latch (e2m 10B1 +18 EPF_Shutdown_Override_Flag) and clears the pending flag. governor_faultDerate_mainLoop_update (0x508898) consumes the latch: it sets the shutdown timers back to their warning time, starts the override lamp flag and clears the latch at the end of its channel loop. Called by cm848_runFaultDerateScheduler (0x507c44) in task 1, before governor_fault_derateCalc_channelIter. (was governor_derateTrigger_latch_clear)

Selects the rear axle ratio in use for a two-speed axle: rear_axle_ratio (e2m 117D +30 Rear_Axle_Ratio, 1/128 per count) is set from rear_axle_ratio_high_cal (EEPROM 0xb2, e2m 1180 +C Rear_Axle_Ratio_High) and, while switch 31 (switch_input_state_bits[3] bit 0x80) is clear, from rear_axle_ratio_low_cal (EEPROM 0xac, e2m 1180 +6 Rear_Axle_Ratio_Low). The stores run only when two_speed_axle_enable_cal is nonzero; with it 0 the word keeps the start-up value that 0x42770 loads from the HIGH record, whereas cm848_calculateVehicleSpeedFromOutputShaft and cm848_calculateDrivetrainRatioFromVehicleSpeed use the LOW record in that single-speed case. Called every pass of cm848_periodicTaskSet_auxiliaryControl. Inputs: two_speed_axle_enable_cal, switch 31, the two ratio records. Output: rear_axle_ratio (read by cm848_processGovernorSpeedSetpoint, cm848_calculateRiseLimitedVehicleSpeed and cm848_calculateCruisePidRateGainScale). 453 = 3.54 in the dump for all three words; two_speed_axle_enable_cal is 0 there. (was cm848_applyProtectionControlLimit)

Start-up initializer of the rear axle ratio in use: rear_axle_ratio (e2m 117D +30 Rear_Axle_Ratio, 1/128 per count) = rear_axle_ratio_high_cal (EEPROM 0xb2, e2m 1180 +C Rear_Axle_Ratio_High). Called once from the boot list of cm848_applicationMain, just before the divisor calculation 0x5268e8. The value stays in use on a single-speed axle (two_speed_axle_enable_cal = 0: the periodic select 0x4272c then stores nothing) and is the start value on a two-speed axle, where the periodic select replaces it with rear_axle_ratio_low_cal while switch 31 is clear. 453 = 3.54 in the dump. (was cm848_setProtectionControlValue)

Start-up calculation of the output shaft speed to vehicle speed divisors: protection_trim_divisor_working (0x3fd062) = rear_axle_ratio_low_cal x protection_timing_period_cal and protection_trim_divisor_cal (0x3fd066) = rear_axle_ratio_high_cal x protection_timing_period_cal, one dword each. The ratio words are e2m 1180 +6 / +C (1/128 per count); protection_timing_period_cal (EEPROM mirror 0x3fee7a) is e2m 132C +0 Tire_Size, the number of tire revolutions per mile (the e2m range is 300-725; 251 in the dump). cm848_calculateVehicleSpeedFromOutputShaft divides output_shaft_speed_current (1/8 rpm) x 0x3c000 (= 256 x 60 x 128 / 8) by the _cal divisor when two_speed_axle_enable_cal is on and switch 31 is set, else by the _working one, which gives vehicle speed in 1/256 mph. Called once from the boot list of cm848_applicationMain, after the rear axle ratio initializer 0x42770. 113703 = 453 x 251 for both in the dump. (was cm848_computeProtectionTrimDivisors)

Drivetrain ratio update, one pass of cm848_periodicTaskSet_outputs (skipped while drivetrain_type is DRIVETRAIN_STANDALONE). The ratio is engine speed over vehicle (or output shaft) speed x 2048. While vehicle_speed is below vehicle_speed_minimum or the engine is stopped it reseeds drivetrain_ratio_raw, drivetrain_ratio, fuel_flow_rpm_divisor, fuel_flow_rpm_divisor_saved and the filter accumulator with drivetrain_ratio_default and sets drivetrain_ratio_unsettled_flag. Otherwise, on the drivetrain types without a J1939 speed, it computes drivetrain_ratio_raw = vehicle_speed_sensor_period x drivetrain_ratio_period_scale_cal (e2m 1195 +2 GR_Constant) x 16 / drivetrain_ratio_engine_period_average (0x7ffd = not computable); the J1939 types get it elsewhere. It low-pass filters drivetrain_ratio_raw into drivetrain_ratio (the settled or the out-of-gear filter coefficient), checks it against the minimum / maximum limits and tolerances (in window: fuel_flow_rpm_divisor = drivetrain_ratio; outside: fuel_flow_divisor_invalid_flag = 1, the raw ratio is clamped and drivetrain_ratio_change_settle_counter is reloaded) and runs the out-of-gear timers (drivetrain_ratio_decoupled_hold_counter, drivetrain_ratio_unsettled_release_timer; e2m 106C +6 / +8) that clear drivetrain_ratio_unsettled_flag (e2m 117D +E Out_Of_Gear) only when all are 0. It also publishes governor_bypass_threshold_low / _high (from top_gear_ratio_cal, e2m 1185 +A), sets governor_j1939_bypass_flag to 1 / 2 / 3 as drivetrain_ratio is below the low / below the high / above the high threshold, and commits fuel_flow_rpm_divisor_saved once the divisor is stable and final_fueling is above its threshold. (was protectionTimeoutControl)

Requests a delay of the ECM power-down while the vehicle is moving: sets ecm_power_down_delay_request_flag (e2m 117D +4C Powerdown_Delay_Request, '[SDDYFG] The ECM will not powerdown until this is inactive') to 1 when vehicle_speed_unfiltered (1/256 mph, from the speed sensor or the J1939 output shaft speed) is nonzero, and never clears it. cm848_updateEngineState starts the delayed power-down in SHUTDOWN only while the flag is 0 and clears it at the end of every SHUTDOWN pass. Runs every pass of cm848_periodicTaskSet_sensorProcessing. On this truck the speed reads 0 (no speed sensor wired), so the flag is never set (0 in the dump). (was cm848_setFuelDemandActiveFlag)

Accumulates the converter clutch rationality ratio delta: converter_clutch_rationality_ratio_delta_sum (e2m 8C34 +9 TCC_Rationality_Sum_Ratio_Delta, signed word, 1/256) = signed 16-bit saturating sum of itself and protection_pid_error_term (the ratio delta that 0x51ba6c just calculated); it clamps at -32768 / 32767. Called by cm848_monitorConverterClutchAndOverdrivePerformance (the P1740 converter clutch / overdrive performance monitor) right after each ratio delta, at the start of an engagement and on each timed step. The monitor judges the sum against protection_pid_integrator_threshold (e2m 8C33 +7 TCC_Rationality_Min_Ratio_Delta) when the rationality timer reaches its limit. It is a plain running sum, not a PID integrator. 0 in the dump. (was cm848_pidIntegrator_accumulate)

Calculates the converter clutch rationality ratio delta: protection_pid_error_term = saturate16(protection_pid_rpm_setpoint_prev - converter_clutch_rationality_ratio), i.e. the previous sample of the engine speed to transmission output speed ratio minus the new sample (converter_clutch_rationality_ratio, e2m 8C34 +7 TCC_Rationality_Ratio, 1/256), clamped to -32768..32767. Called by cm848_monitorConverterClutchAndOverdrivePerformance (the P1740 monitor) after each new ratio sample and followed by the sum update 0x51ba1c; the monitor then stores the new sample into protection_pid_rpm_setpoint_prev. Not a PID error: no setpoint or gain is involved. 0 in the dump. (was cm848_pidError_calc)

TPU-A channel 1 interrupt handler - reached via tpu_a_channel_interrupt_handler_table (mpc555_tpuAInterruptDispatcher 0x55de4) - no direct caller in the decompile. Channel 1 is the cam signal input (the TPU PMA function: e2m 8194 +56 PMA_Edge_Type 'Capture edge for cam signal' is crank_mios_channel1_config_cal, which goes into tpu_a_ch1_param2.PARAM0), so this is the backup engine speed path, not the crank. Per cam pulse it reloads backup_pulse_period_countdown (e2m 819B +A Backup_Lost_Counter) from crank_sync_timing_scale_working; with a nonzero tooth count it stores the 24-bit period of tpu_a_ch1_param2 into the ring crank_period_capture_array (819B +4E Pulse_Period_Table_Backup, index crank_period_capture_index = +3E Next_Table_Position_Backup) and sums it into crank_tooth_period_raw (+6 Average_Pulse_Period_Backup) and engine_rpm_state_t.crank_tooth_period_sum / _sample_count (the backup accumulator +24 and counter +2A). It runs the cam sync state engine_crank_state_t.crank_state (e2m 819C +2 Cam_Sync_State; here 0 NO / 1 LOST / 4 HAVE, driven by the channel status byte), the pattern machine from tpu_a_ch1_param2: start_counter (819C +0 Cam_Sync_Error_Count) rises while LOST above speed_setpoint_minimum and falls while HAVE, and crank_event_timebase_a (819B +72 Cam_Have_Sync_Time) is stored once at HAVE. It compares the crank tooth number of the cam pulse (crank_period_computed from TPUA_CH3_PARAM2, 819B +E Cam_2_Crank_Tooth_Number) with crank_tooth_pattern_table (Cam_2_Crank_Position_Array, 2 x cam_wheel_pulse_count entries), counts matches in crank_tooth_count_a / crank_sync_period_counter and mismatches in crank_sync_timeout_count (819B +10 Cam_Crank_Mismatch_Count), and requests a TPU host service (tpu_a_mcr.HSRR1 = 1) with crank_resync_time_ticks / crank_tbl_event_counter when the crank bank is out of phase, then dispatches the run state handlers and the injection timing (engine_injectionTiming_crankSyncDispatch, cm848_enterSpeedLimpHome). (was mpc555_updateEngineCrankState)

Initializes (resets) the fuel pressure governor / fuel metering state (cm848_calculateFuelMeteringCommand): command, demand, governor mode 1, counters, the table interpolation states and filters. Of the four Q16.16 PID states it clears fuel_pressure_governor_integrator, fuel_metering_feedback_trim_integrator (twice) and fuel_pressure_governor_derivative_filter; fuel_metering_base_command_derivative_filter (0x3fb676) is never cleared because the fourth store pair repeats 0x3fb66e. In detail: fuel_metering_command and fuel_pressure_governor_demand = 0, fuel_pressure_governor_mode and its saved copy = FUEL_PRESSURE_GOVERNOR_OPEN_LOOP_START, the start revolution / low pressure counters and the feed forward = 0, the 17 table lookup cache words engine_sync_init_state_a..q = 2, the EMA filter records of the fuel metering feedback / reference / command, the fuel pressure sensor, the accelerator feed forward and the two cam_sync_* speed filters = accumulator 0 with their coefficient pointers set, fuel_metering_command_filtered = 0, the coil resistance estimate (e2m 8019) preset from engine_sync_rpm_filter_initial_cal and the coolant temperature, and the engine_sync_* flags and governor_zero_speed_count = 0. Called once from the boot list of cm848_applicationMain, before the fuel pressure diagnostic and setpoint state initializers. (was cm848_resetEngineSyncState) | earlier note: Resets the fuel pressure governor / fuel metering state (cm848_calculateFuelMeteringCommand): command, demand, governor mode 1, counters, the table interpolation states and filters. Of the four Q16.16 PID states it clears fuel_pressure_governor_integrator, fuel_metering_feedback_trim_integrator (twice) and fuel_pressure_governor_derivative_filter; fuel_metering_base_command_derivative_filter (0x3fb676) is never cleared because the fourth store pair repeats 0x3fb66e

Cylinder balance fueling filter: while the cylinder balance code is enabled (cbd_enable_flag = 1) or the misfire monitor's speed buffer is enabled (misfire_monitor_speed_buffer_enable_flag = 1) it low-pass filters final_fueling (e2m 1051 +0 Final_Fueling) into cylinder_balance_filtered_fueling (e2m 81B0 +0 CBD_Filtered_Fueling): filtered = final_fueling + (previous filtered - final_fueling) x cbd_fuel_demand_blend_scale_cal / 8192, clamped to 0..5888 (0x1700). That word is the fueling axis of the cylinder balance tables and the zero-fuel test of hpcr_cbdCalculateCylinderTrims. Runs every pass of cm848_periodicTaskSet_controlLoop. There is no throttle or load input. (was hpcr_processLoadThrottle)

Initializes the injection angle scheduler, the TPU-A channel 6 per-cylinder injection event channel (handled by engine_injectionAngle_tpuChannel6EventHandler): sets injection_angle_sequence_state (e2m 805E +0 HPCR_Wakeup_Processing_Status_N) to 1 and injection_tpu_period_parameter_address (805E +B HPCR_Period_Address) to 2 (the primary speed input, TPU-A channel 0 parameter 1 at 0x304102), sets up channel 6 (CFSR2 function field 9, host service request 3 in HSRR1, channel interrupt enable bit 0x40 in CIER, priority field of CPR1; TPUA_CH6_PARAM0 = 0x6002 = 0x6000 | the period address) and stores injection_timing_tooth_separation_per_cylinder (805E +C HPCR_Wakeup_Seperation_In_Increments) = injection_timing_tooth_count / cylinder_event_count_max (120 / 6 = 20). Called once from the boot list of cm848_applicationMain and again by cm848_updateEngineSpeedFromCrankSignal after engine_rpm_measured has dropped to 0, right after mpc555_resetEngineTimingAccumulators. (was cm848_sensor_diagnostic_flag_update)

Pressure sensor agreement check (e2m 165C: Ambient_Air_Sensor_Tolerence, Boost_Sensor_Tolerence, Oil_Sensor_Tolerence, Pressure_Check_Delay_Time), run once by cm848_processSensorDeviationOnKeyoff after the engine has been stopped for cold_start_sensor_deviation_delay_cal while algorithm_enable_flags_6_cal bit 0x20 is set. It compares three pressure readings, sensor_readings_t.barometric_pressure, governor_integrator_bound_a (sensor_channel_filtered_output[77], paired with the boost tolerance) and governor_integrator_bound_b ([38], paired with the oil tolerance), using barometric_pressure_sensor_tolerance, boost_pressure_sensor_tolerance and oil_pressure_sensor_tolerance. A sensor is flagged when it differs from both of the other two by more than the sum of its own tolerance and the other sensor's tolerance: mask 4 / 8 / 0x10 of fault_detected_bits_592_to_607 (faults 594 / 595 / 596, e2m 1036 +4A System_Error_Status_37, no DTC) for the barometric / first / second sensor. A bit and the same bit of its registered twin j1939_tsc1_mode_shadow (0x3fea22) are cleared when that sensor agrees with at least one other; all three bits are cleared when one of the sensor circuit faults the check depends on is set (fault_detected_bits_16_to_31 0x200 / 0x400, fault_detected_bits_0_to_15 0x100 / 0x200 / 0x1000 / 0x2000). Outputs: those three flag bits. (was cm848_checkSensorDeviationFlags)

Updates not_safe_to_program_flag (e2m 000D +0 SAFE2PRG / Safe_To_Program: 'Indicator to tools (0 = safe for program, 1 = not safe)'): 1 while engine_state is not ENGINE_STATE_STOPPED, else 0. Runs every pass of cm848_periodicTaskSet_auxiliaryControl. Input: engine_state. Output: not_safe_to_program_flag. While it is 1 the force-activate diagnostic service answers DIAG_NACK_PROTECTED, cm848_commitEepromMirrorToEeprom refuses, the diagnostic EEPROM writes (j1939_writeDiagMemory, the PCI write service) answer 7 unless diagnostic_session_state is INACTIVE, and cm848_lookupParameterIdAddress maps EEPROM parameter addresses to the RAM mirror. It handles no fault and no key-off event. (was cm848_updateFaultOnKeyoff)

Controls the malfunction indicator lamp (MIL) override of the Chrysler in-plant end-of-line test. param_1 is a step code, not the e2m EOL_Mil_State coding: 0 = clear the saved override (diag_suppress_saved_flag) and the override; 1 = save the current override into diag_suppress_saved_flag, request the lamp flash (end_of_line_test_malfunction_indicator_lamp_flash_request_flag = 1) and clear the override while the step runs; 2 = restore the saved override and clear the flash request; 3 = lamp on: save 1, override = 1, no flash request. Outputs: end_of_line_test_malfunction_indicator_lamp_override_state (e2m 1226 +C EOL_Mil_State; cm848_updateMilOnRequest forces the MIL request on while it is 1) and the flash request (e2m 1226 +D EOL_Mil_Flash, sent in bit 5 of PCI TX[3] byte 1 by cm848_buildPciTransmitMessage3MilAndDtcDisplay while the field mode register is 5100). Called by the end-of-line test sequencer and its steps (cm848_runEndOfLineTestSequence, cm848_runEndOfLineMisfireTestStep and the cold start, deviation, battery voltage and bit check steps) and, with step 3, by cm848_initialization_group21_state_cont at start-up when the failed-test power-down flag (e2m 1981 +1 EOL_MIL_Powerdown_State) is 1. (was diag_suppress_stateMachine)

OBD warm-up cycle monitor (e2m 1226 +9 Warm_Up_Cycle_Flag, '[DGWUCYFL] Indicates whether warm up cycle has occurred'; it makes no coolant overheat check). Sets bit 0 of warm_up_cycle_condition_flags when coolant_temp has risen more than 0x9ff (about 40 degrees F; 1/64 degree per count) above warm_up_cycle_start_coolant_temperature (the sample taken after the startup delay) and bit 1 when coolant_temp is above warm_up_cycle_minimum_coolant_temperature (e2m 11F9 +2 Warm_Up_Temp_Max, 8960 = 140 degrees F). With both set (3) a warm-up cycle has occurred: it stops evaluating, adds 1 to fault_auto_clear_warm_up_cycle_count_cal (counts 0..39, then 0) and calls fault_ring_buffer_auto_clear_emission, which clears the fault ring. Called by cm848_mainLoopServiceMonitor. 0 in the dump (engine off). (was engine_coolantTemp_overheat_monitor)

Removes one entry from the engine start counts since a fault was logged (engine_start_count_since_fault_logged_cal, word[8], e2m 138F +2 Number_Of_Starts_1..8): for i = param_1 .. 6 it copies count[i] = count[i + 1], so every older entry moves one slot toward index 0 and closes the gap (index 7 keeps its value). Opposite direction of 0x533b94, which opens index 0 for a new fault. (was diag_protection_history_shiftIn)

Opens index 0 of the engine start counts since a fault was logged (engine_start_count_since_fault_logged_cal, word[8], e2m 138F +2 Number_Of_Starts_1..8): for i = 7 down to 1 it copies count[i] = count[i - 1] (read at 0x3fedcc + 2 i), so every entry ages one slot toward index 7 and the oldest (index 7) is dropped. Called by cm848_latchNewlyActiveFault when a fault latches for the first time, right after it has shifted protection_event_spn_history the same way and written the new code at index 0; the caller then sets count[0] = 0.
