Duty cycle monitor load histogram (e2m group DC_Mon; enable 106B +26 DC_Mon_Enable = bit 3 of algorithm_enable_flags_18_cal), one sample per call of cm848_periodicTaskSet_outputs2 (1 count = 0.1 s in the e2m). While the monitor is enabled and the engine is not stopped: when load_histogram_total_sample_count_cal is 0 it first stores engine_hour_meter in load_histogram_start_engine_hours_cal; fuel_demand_histogram_load_ratio = (final_fueling - fuel_demand_base_offset) x 10000 / (the maximum fueling at the engine speed, from cm848_lookupChiMaximumFuelAtSpeed with the speed limited by the e2m 111C DC_Mon_Low / High_Cutoff_RPM, minus fuel_demand_base_offset), clamped at 13000 and copied to duty_cycle_monitor_load_factor (e2m 111F +0 DC_Mon_Load_Factor, 0.01 percent; 0 when the ratio is negative); the engine speed is binned against the 8 breakpoints of e2m 111D DC_Mon_RPM_Axis (ROM 0x5c2c0) and the load against the 10 of 111E DC_Mon_Load_Axis (0x5c2d4) into one of 80 fine counters, a negative load into counter 81 or 82, and the counter number is stored in DAT_0040a64a (e2m 111F +2 DC_Mon_Operating_Region); that fine counter and load_histogram_total_sample_count_cal (e2m 1122 +4 DC_Mon_Long_Map_Total, up to 3,600,000,000 = 100,000 h) get +1; percent_time_at_load_cal[0..9] (25600 = 100 percent, the DRB '% OF TIME @ x LOAD' words) are recomputed as each load band's 8 counters x 25600 / total, plus the two out-of-range percentages in 0x3fdfac / 0x3fdfae. The counters are the 82 dwords from 0x3fde4e (their sum equals the total in the dump, 3203448; e2m 1125 DC_Mon_Long_Term_Map resolves 2 bytes earlier, to 0x3fde4c). When the monitor is off or the engine is stopped it only acts on duty_cycle_monitor_map_reset_pending_flag (e2m 111F +3 DC_Mon_Map_Reset): it zeroes the total, the counters and the percent words and clears the flag. (was cm848_outputs2_periodic)

RAM refresh initializer: fills the one block descriptor of the refresh table (12-byte entries at 0x3fd2c4: RAM start sensor_channel_cal_block_start 0x3feed0, RAM end sensor_channel_ram_start 0x40a046, source ROM 0x64aea), points the current-descriptor cursor at 0x3fd2d0 at it, restarts the compare cursors (sensor_cal_ram_write_ptr = the RAM start, sensor_cal_rom_read_ptr = the ROM source), clears sensor_cal_write_dirty_flag, sets diagnostic_session_state = ACTIVE (e2m 10C7 +0 RAM_Refresh_Enable = 1), sensor_validation_result = 1 (e2m 10C7 +2 Powerdown_Refresh_Enable) and sensor_cal_session_state_prev = 1. Called only by cm848_initProtectionModule (the refresh pass) on its first pass and whenever the refresh has just been enabled again (sensor_cal_session_state_prev = 0 while diagnostic_session_state is not INACTIVE). (was uds_session_state_init)

RAM refresh pass - the body of the background loop of cm848_applicationMain and cm848_restartApplicationWithoutReset (do { ... } while (power_down_start_flag == 0)). While diagnostic_session_state is not INACTIVE (e2m 10C7 +0 RAM_Refresh_Enable = 1) each call compares up to 100 bytes (50 words) of the current block of the refresh table with its source and rewrites every RAM word that differs (sensor_cal_write_dirty_flag = 1). The one block is the sensor channel calibration block (sensor_channel_cal_block_start .. sensor_channel_ram_start, 0x3feed0-0x40a046) against ROM 0x64aea (the EEPROM mirror ends before it, at 0x3feec1); the EEPROM side of the refresh is the periodic mirror reload (cm848_periodicTaskSet_protection2 -> cm848_startEepromBlockRead, 30 words per read, copied in by cm848_onEepromBlockRead only while diagnostic_session_state is not INACTIVE). When a cycle through all blocks ends it sets fault bit 0 (fault_detected_bits_0_to_15 |= 1, e2m 1036 +0 RAM_Image_Word_Error 'RAM refresh generated error'; fault 0 -> ROM slot table 0x5985a -> obd_dtc_code_table = P0606) if any word was rewritten during the cycle, else clears it; it counts cycles in sensor_cal_ring_cycle_count. It calls uds_session_state_init when the refresh has just been enabled (sensor_cal_session_state_prev = 0) and clears fault bit 0 on that edge. It does nothing while the refresh is disabled (development mode). (was cm848_initProtectionModule)
